name: Prerolls
overview: Plays a random pre-roll video before movies and/or TV episodes.
description: Injects a randomly-selected video from a local folder before movies, TV episodes, or both. Built for Adult Swim bumps on Jellyfin 10.11. No Cinema Mode required.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Supports Movies, TV Shows, or Both. Targets Jellyfin 10.11.
